notes.title: Announcing: PUNZEL Demo Release @ Steam Next (19th of June)!
notes.notes:
Hear ye, hear ye, all Gobbos of SKULL!

This month holds something special in store. While the Punzel Team is working on finalizing the Gametoon and adding the final finishing touches, we are delighted to announce that during the second half of this month, you will have the opportunity to get a preview of the game by playing our FREE DEMO on Steam.

The demo will be available at the start of the [b]Steam Next Festival[/b], from the [b]19th to the 26th of June, at 10:00 AM PDT (07:00 PM CEST)[/b].

During this time, you will also have the chance to interact with the developers [b]live on Steam[/b]. We will be streaming live on [b]Tuesday the 20th and Saturday the 24th of June at 10:00 AM PDT (07:00 PM CEST)[/b]. We’re looking forward to meeting you there!

Additionally, we will be hosting an [b]art contest during Steam Next[/b]. More information on how to participate will be provided later this month, so get ready to have a chance to win cool prizes straight out of Punzel's world.

If you are bored like Punzel you can get fresh updates, devlogs, tidbits, and small video content on our [b]Discord [/b](https://discord.gg/HcEyFstqX9) and [b]Instagram [/b] (@princesspunzelworld).

Have a wonderful start to the month - we are eagerly looking forward to meeting you!
